name: dsh-desktop
description: DeepSeek Harness 独立桌面客户端 / Independent desktop client powered by the official dsh Web UI
author: bruc3van

scripts.build:shell: esbuild src/main/index.ts --bundle --platform=node --format=esm --external:electron --outfile=.build/main.mjs && esbuild src/main/preload.ts --bundle --platform=node --format=cjs --external:electron --outfile=.build/preload.cjs && esbuild src/main/runtime-launcher.ts --bundle --platform=node --format=esm --external:electron --outfile=.build/runtime-launcher.mjs
scripts.pack: npm run build && npm run prepare:runtime && npm run check:picker && npm run check:runtime-env && electron-builder --dir
scripts.dist: npm run build && npm run prepare:runtime && npm run check:picker && npm run check:runtime-env && electron-builder --publish never
